title: 煅玉堂 第八十五章 有所感煅玉堂 第八十四章 完成闻獜约定
content_zh:
这一淬炼过程不艰难，当然，这只是对秦凤鸣而言不艰难，因为远不及他伴劫时恐怖天劫能量淬体恐怖。
但如果换做他人，定然是生死两难，凄惨痛苦。
短短几个月时间，秦凤鸣便消耗了比真仙修士还要多两三倍的材料。如果有人见到，定然会目瞪口呆。
因为那片粉尘区域浓度太高了，就是真仙都会感觉头皮发麻。
如果与真仙比拼肉身坚韧，秦凤鸣真就比不过。但如果只是比拼体内经脉粗大韧性，哪怕是在真仙中存活了数百万年存在，也未必能够与秦凤鸣相比。因为秦凤鸣从进入修仙界，他体内能运转的能量就是同阶的数倍。
不知经历多少次天劫雷电能量洗礼，让他体内经脉坚韧超乎想象。
秦凤鸣非常满意，这里的诡异能量虽然不是天劫能量，但对经脉的锤炼比经历一次天劫洗礼还要有效果。
半年时间不知不觉间过去，随着一股传送力包裹全身，秦凤鸣知道时间到了。
随着一阵恍惚涌现，秦凤鸣出现在了广场上。
“秦大师没事就好。”汤巍真仙见到秦凤鸣，登时放心下来。
“汤巍真仙，请发布一个悬赏，就说秦某要炼制玄牝锁阳丹，每一份材料兑换一枚玄牝锁阳丹，有意者三日内观云楼签订约定。不过只限额五十份，先到先得，过期不候。”秦凤鸣冲汤巍真仙抱拳，立即开口道。
他本就答应汤巍真仙炼制玄牝锁阳丹，而这次经过体内经脉淬炼，他忽然觉察到体内有了异样，需要闭关参悟一番。而对秦凤鸣而言，闭关参悟，不及炼制丹药来的效果好。
“好，这事好办。”汤巍真仙立即大喜点头。
六竺真仙、芦湛真仙、户亮金仙与蓝冰辞别离去了，有了汤巍真仙相伴秦凤鸣，他们自然不便再插手。一番话别后，几人出离了连云城。
秦凤鸣则带着董迁、丁原，跟着汤巍真仙回到了观云楼。
随着一项悬赏公布在连云城，无数修士开始传播，很快整个坊市便被这一消息所引动。反应最是剧烈的，当属那些宗门商盟店铺。虽然也有不少真仙心中大动。身为真仙，当然听到过玄牝锁阳丹炼制困难，这次一位仙境修士竟扬言要炼制此丹，嗤之以鼻之人不在少数。
而一份材料价值不菲，愿意拿出一份材料之人真就没有几人。故此真仙中反应并不如何激烈。
然而秦凤鸣也并不指望有多少真仙修士会签约兑换。他目的是让那些商盟、宗门店铺出资。那些店铺财大气粗，不会在意一份材料。如果真能得到一枚玄牝锁阳丹，那价值就大了去了。
以前，秦凤鸣并不想将自己丹道显露在人前，但与魔阴宫扯上关系后，他忽然发现，自己丹师身份会给他不小安全感。至少魔阴宫修士以后行事，第一反应是不会将他出手直接灭杀。
一位能够炼制玄牝锁阳丹的丹道大家，对一个宗门而言，绝对会奉为上宾。

这是秦凤鸣给自己设置的一个护身符，只要不是一上来就奔着将他灭杀之念出手，他活命机会就大增。
让秦凤鸣没有想到的是，第一个登门的，竟然是四海商盟。并且一出手就是三份材料。
有了第一个，立即便有第二个，第三个……
煅玉堂来的是一位金仙，见到秦凤鸣，满脸震惊的盯瞧秦凤鸣许久：“秦大师原来丹道与炼器都是顶尖存在，如此人物，阚芜仙域中不能说绝无仅有，但也不会超过十指之数。”
content_en:
This tempering process is not difficult. Of course, it is not difficult only for Qin Fengming, because it is far less terrifying than the terrifying calamity energy tempering body he had during the calamity.
But if it were anyone else, it would definitely be a dilemma between life and death, miserable and painful.
In just a few months, Qin Fengming consumed two or three times more materials than a True Immortal cultivator. If anyone saw it, they would be stunned.
Because the dust concentration in that area is so high, even a true immortal would feel his scalp numb.
If he could compete with a true immortal in terms of physical toughness, Qin Fengming really couldn't compare. But if they were just competing for the strength and toughness of the meridians in their bodies, even if they had survived among true immortals for millions of years, they might not be able to compare with Qin Fengming. Because Qin Fengming entered the world of cultivating immortals, the energy he can operate in his body is several times that of the same level.
He had experienced countless thunder and lightning energy baptisms, which made the meridians in his body tougher than imagined.
Qin Fengming was very satisfied. Although the strange energy here was not the energy of the Heavenly Tribulation, it was more effective in tempering the meridians than experiencing the baptism of the Heavenly Tribulation.
Half a year passed unknowingly. As a wave of teleportation force enveloped his whole body, Qin Fengming knew that the time had come.
With a trance emerging, Qin Fengming appeared in the square.
"Master Qin, just be fine." Immortal Tang Wei immediately felt relieved when he saw Qin Fengming.
"True Immortal Tang Wei, please post a reward, saying that Qin wants to refine Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill. Each piece of material will be exchanged for one Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill. Those who are interested will sign an agreement in Guanyun Tower within three days. However, the limit is only fifty copies, first come first served, no waiting after the expiration date." Qin Fengming clasped his fists at Tang Wei and said immediately.
He had promised Immortal Tang Wei to refine the Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill, but this time after tempering the meridians in his body, he suddenly realized that there was something strange in his body, and he needed to retreat for some meditation. For Qin Fengming, retreating for enlightenment is not as effective as refining elixirs.
"Okay, this matter is easy to handle." Immortal Tang Wei immediately nodded with joy.
True Immortal Liu Zhu, True Immortal Lu Zhan, Immortal Hu Liang Jin and Lan Bing said goodbye. With True Immortal Tang Wei accompanying Qin Fengming, it was naturally inconvenient for them to interfere. After saying goodbye, several people left Lianyuncheng.
Qin Fengming took Dong Qian and Ding Yuan and followed Immortal Tang Wei back to Guanyun Tower.
As a reward was announced in Lianyun City, countless monks began to spread the news, and soon the entire city was attracted by the news. The most violent reaction was undoubtedly from those sect merchant alliance stores. Although many true immortals were greatly moved. As a true immortal, of course I have heard about the difficulties in refining the Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill. This time, a fairyland monk actually threatened to refine this pill, and many people scoffed.
And a piece of material is worth a lot of money, and there are really not many people who are willing to give out a piece of material. Therefore, the reaction among the True Immortals was not very intense.
However, Qin Fengming did not expect many True Immortal monks to sign the contract and redeem it. His purpose was to get those business alliances and sect shops to contribute capital. Those shops have deep pockets and won’t care about a piece of material. If you can really get a Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill, the value will be great.
In the past, Qin Fengming did not want to reveal his alchemy skills to others, but after getting involved with the Demon Yin Palace, he suddenly discovered that his identity as an alchemist would give him a sense of security. At least when the monks from the Demonic Palace act in the future, their first reaction will not be to kill him directly.
A master of alchemy who can refine Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill will definitely be regarded as a distinguished guest for a sect.
This is a talisman Qin Fengming set for himself. As long as he doesn't rush to kill him as soon as he comes up, his chance of survival will be greatly increased.
What Qin Fengming didn't expect was that the first person to come to the door was the Sihai Merchant Alliance. And there are three materials when you take action.
With the first one, there is immediately the second one, the third one...
A golden immortal came to the Jade Hall. When he saw Qin Fengming, he stared at Qin Fengming in shock for a long time: "Master Qin turns out to be a top existence in alchemy and weapon refining. Such a person, in the Kanwu Immortal Domain,It cannot be said that it is unique, but it cannot be more than ten fingers. "
